items.title: Baker Hughes and Venture Global Advance Next Phase of U.S. Gas Infrastructure Growth
items.category: ガスタービン・技術サービス
items.excerpt: Baker Hughes says the Cloud Connector Pipeline award includes 13 gas-compression systems driven by Frame 5/2E gas turbines. A separate Plaquemines LNG expansion award covers four liquefaction blocks/eight modules using electric-driven SMR trains with Baker Hughes centrifugal compressors, cold boxes and integrated controls.
items.query: site:investors.bakerhughes.com/news/press-releases September 2026 gas compression systems Venture Global

items.title: Chromalloy and Lufthansa Technik Achieve Fifth V2500 Select PMA Approval with New High Pressure Turbine Stage 1 Blade
items.excerpt: Chromalloy announced FAA PMA certification of a new V2500 Select high-pressure-turbine Stage 1 blade, the fifth V2500 approval with Lufthansa Technik. It says the program added anti-corrosion and multilayer thermal-barrier coating capability plus in-house smelting, casting, machining and coating, with production ramping into 2027.
items.query: site:chromalloy.com September 2026 V2500 Select PMA high pressure turbine Stage 1 blade

items.title: IBM Ventures Invests in BQP as Quantum-Algorithm Physics Acceleration Reaches Production
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: BQP announced an IBM Ventures investment to scale BQPhy, a physics-acceleration platform already used with aerospace/defense customers, from engineering design into operational decision workflows. Its focus on full-physics computation, optimization and future quantum integration makes BQP a high-value emerging CAE/scientific-AI watch source.
items.query: site:bqp.ai September 2026 IBM Ventures physics acceleration aerospace official

items.title: Venus Aerospace Opens New Propulsion Test Stand at Houston Spaceport
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: Venus Aerospace opened a propulsion test stand at Houston Spaceport for higher-thrust, longer-duration hot-fire testing under more mission-like conditions, including its rotating-detonation rocket engine. The recurring RDRE development and propulsion-test infrastructure make it a strong advanced-propulsion watch candidate.

items.title: Aerospace suppliers test rare-earth alternatives to ease reliance on China
items.category: 航空機材料・タービン
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: Reuters reports Oerlikon Metco already sells rare-earth-free thermal-barrier coatings and has further zirconia-based Mg/Ca-oxide systems in development as aerospace suppliers respond to rare-earth shortages. Its direct role in turbine-coating materials and substitution R&D makes Oerlikon Metco a strong watchlist candidate.
items.query: site:oerlikon.com September 2026 Metco rare-earth-free turbine coatings aerospace official

items.title: Stratasys Brings Production-Proven Additive Manufacturing to IMTS 2026 Across Aerospace, Defense, Automotive and Healthcare Applications
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: Stratasys outlined production additive workflows for aerospace/defense at IMTS, including the F870 1 m heated-chamber FDM system with Nylon 12CF support and an Additive App Suite for rapid fixture/tooling design. Its production hardware, qualified materials and digital-manufacturing updates make it useful for advanced-manufacturing monitoring.
